dataset-of-origin.detail: Clinical cohorts drawn from HCP-psychosis (HCP-EP) and ASRB datasets.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "This study comprised a total of 1849 participants drawn from three independent datasets: (1) the Human Connectome Project-Young Adult Sample [15]; (2) the Human Connectome Project for Early Psychosis (HCPpsychosis) [16]; and (3) the Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB) [17]."

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD computed across schizophrenia cases in HCP-psychosis (n=140; 22.78 ± 3.83) and ASRB (n=335; 39.70 ± 10.81).

sex.detail: Counts and percentages computed by combining schizophrenia cases from HCP-psychosis (48 females of 140) and ASRB (100 females of 335); male counts derived from total N.
